maddeler.e:
انفضحت (form VII)
# اِنْفَضَحْتُ (infaḍaḥtu) /in.fa.dˤaħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
# اِنْفَضَحْتَ (infaḍaḥta) /in.fa.dˤaħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
# اِنْفَضَحْتِ (infaḍaḥti) /in.fa.dˤaħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
# اِنْفَضَحَتْ (infaḍaḥat) /in.fa.dˤa.ħat/: third-pe
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
